integrity: The infinite claim is proved symbolically from the divisor-sum identity and strict finite-prime-power abundancy bounds. The finite checker is supplementary only. Originality remains subject to the stated residual historical-overlap risk.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a necessary condition only, restricted to exact prime support \(\{2,p,q\}\). It does not prove existence or nonexistence and does not bound the exponents \(\alpha,\beta\).
title: A finite hyperbolic sieve for three-prime-support almost perfect numbers
